known_limitations: Single-image, seven-class classification only; the model does not detect, count, or localize objects.
The mixed_scrap class scores 0.18 precision on a two-example evaluation set; it over-triggers and must not be trusted without manual confirmation.
Recall for air_conditioners is 0.67, so roughly a third of air conditioners are misfiled into other categories.
Field performance may differ under occlusion, poor lighting, unusual viewpoints, or out-of-distribution items.
Low-confidence and ambiguous predictions require manual category confirmation.
